title: A Homotopy Framework for Constrained Multiobjective Optimization
summary: We develop a homotopy continuation framework for computing Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) points of constrained multiobjective optimization problems. The proposed homotopy map continuously deforms an easily solvable system into the KKT system associated with the original multiobjective problem, yielding a deterministic continuation path. Under the stated regularity and reference-point cone avoidance assumptions, we establish the existence of a smooth, bounded continuation path whose set of accumulation points as the homotopy parameter approaches zero is nonempty and consists of KKT points.
